objective: After this, a child in group 7-10 can compute how many years it took to build the Lincoln Memorial (from 1914 to 1922, 8 years) and identify that the statue of Abraham Lincoln inside sits rather than stands, shown by a correct answer to the opening years question and a correct tap on the post-clip retrieval check.
why: Work on the Lincoln Memorial began in 1914. It opened in 1922. How many years did it take to build?

place.name: Lincoln Memorial, National Mall, Washington, D.C., United States

retrieval.question: In the big statue, does Lincoln sit or stand?
